subject: general
question: Who among the following became the first Indian player to score 1,000 T20 International runs in a calendar year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suryakumar Yadav.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Suryakumar Yadav:-**

 
 
• He became the first Indian player to score 1,000 T20 International runs in a calendar year.
 
• He achieved this feat in the year 2021 during the T20 World Cup held in the United Arab Emirates.
 
• Suryakumar Yadav played a crucial role in India's campaign in the T20 World Cup, scoring 193 runs in 7 innings at an average of 38.60 and a strike rate of 144.69.
 
• He has been in good form in the domestic T20 tournaments as well, scoring heavily for his franchise Mumbai Indians in the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
 

 ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Rishabh Pant:-**

 
 
• He is a wicketkeeper-batsman who has been in great form in the recent past.
 
• He has played some match-winning knocks in T20 Internationals for India.
 
 
 
• **Rohit Sharma:-**
 
 
• He is one of the most successful batsmen in T20 Internationals for India.
 
• He has scored more than 2,900 runs in the format at an average of 32.52 and a strike rate of 138.78.
 
 
 
• **Virat Kohli:-**
 
 
• He is the captain of the Indian cricket team and is considered to be one of the best batsmen in the world.
 
• He has scored more than 3,000 runs in T20 Internationals for India at an average of 50.80 and a strike rate of 138.40.
